Page 94 uses an explicit asterisk note for Denver Auditorium Arena on 1956-57 and 1957-58 named games, but none of these 19 uppercase HOME rows has that venue footnote; no building is named for 19.

Academy 1955-58 cadets were temporarily at Lowry in Denver, permanent campus transferred 1958-08-29; institutional campus location alone cannot identify away or HOME varsity game arena.
Lowry campus Building 863 Cadet Gymnasium and annex 867 existed; no reliable evidence they hosted any of the 19 HOME games; geographic conflict with accepted Colorado Springs HOME evidence.

Eastern New Mexico/Creighton/Drake official reciprocal site records support Colorado Springs/El Paso County but do not identify buildings; accepted published Creighton reciprocal 1958-01-29 likewise has venue blank. 1959 Academy yearbook index checked without accessible exact-game venue. convergence_reason: After the first-party all-time results and exact-season schedules, institutional facility chronology, temporary-campus historical archives, reciprocal institutional schedules, accepted published Creighton source side, and indexed yearbook opportunity, the exact physical building for any of the 19 HOME games has not been established. Do not replace missing physical identity with Denver Auditorium Arena, Lowry Cadet Gymnasium, or permanent Cadet Gymnasium. City/state supported Colorado Springs CO and retained. A secondary Drake Gymnasium label is not independently usable and physically ambiguous.
do_not_reopen_without: New authoritative exact building evidence or genuine contrary accepted project fact.
reopening_scope: Any newly found physical venue evidence must be reconciled against 19 exact IDs; this checkpoint does not close other Research obligations.
